headlines.title: 四部门联合发布22条措施 健全金融机构治理
headlines.summary: 金融监管总局、中国人民银行、中国证监会、财政部近日联合发布《关于健全金融机构治理的实施意见》，提出22条措施。 《实施意见》明确，到2029年，基本形成权责边界清晰、激励约束相容、风险管理严格、运转规范高效的金融机构治理机制，金融体系内在稳定性和抗风险能力明显增强，金融服务高质量发展质效明显提升。

headlines.title_en: Four departments jointly issue 22 measures to improve financial institution governance
headlines.summary_en: The National Financial Regulatory Administration, the People's Bank of China, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, and the Ministry of Finance recently jointly issued the "Implementation Opinions on Improving Corporate Governance of Financial Institutions," proposing 22 measures. The Implementation Opinions clarify that by 2029, a financial institution governance mechanism with clearly defined rights and responsibilities, compatible incentive and constraint mechanisms, strict risk management, and standardized and efficient operations will be basically formed, significantly enhancing the intrinsic stability and risk resilience of the financial system and notably improving the quality and efficiency of high-quality financial services for development.

headlines.title_en: Vanke elects Xu Enli as chairman
headlines.summary_en: On July 31, Vanke held its first extraordinary shareholders' meeting of 2026, reviewing and approving the board of directors' re-election proposal. The announcement of the first board meeting resolution of the new term showed that Xu Enli was elected as the company's chairman, and Huang Yu was re-appointed as the company's president. Vanke stated that Xu Enli has long been engaged in corporate management, deeply rooted in the real estate field for many years, and has served as the head of companies listed on both the A-share and Hong Kong stock exchanges. The partnership between Xu Enli and President Huang Yu aligns with Vanke's corporate characteristics and the current situation, which is conducive to continuously advancing risk resolution and development.

headlines.title_en: CSRC issues warning letter to Li Zhoufeng
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, July 31: After investigation, the CSRC found that GuoYuan Securities Co., Ltd. had issues such as inadequate due diligence in underwriting and sponsorship projects; lax quality control and internal review; and inadequate investigation and rectification of integrity-related issues. These situations violated Article 6 of the "Measures for Compliance Management of Securities Companies and Securities Investment Fund Management Companies" (hereinafter referred to as the "Compliance Measures"), Articles 31 and 37 of the "Measures for the Administration of Sponsorship Business for Securities Issuance and Listing" (hereinafter referred to as the "Sponsorship Measures"), Articles 55 and 61 of the "Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies," and Article 5 of the "Provisions on Integrity Practice for Securities and Futures Operating Institutions and Their Staff." Li Zhoufeng, as the then-person in charge of the company's investment banking business, bears responsibility for the related issues. According to Article 32 of the "Compliance Measures" and Article 64 of the "Sponsorship Measures," the CSRC decided to take [measures] against him.

headlines.title_en: CSRC orders Guoyuan Securities Co., Ltd. to take corrective measures
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, July 31: The CSRC issued a decision to take corrective measures against GuoYuan Securities Co., Ltd. GuoYuan Securities Co., Ltd. has issues such as inadequate due diligence in underwriting and sponsorship projects; lax quality control and internal review; and inadequate investigation and rectification of integrity-related issues. These situations violated Article 6 of the "Compliance Measures," Articles 31 and 37 of the "Sponsorship Measures," Articles 55 and 61 of the "Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies," and Article 5 of the "Provisions on Integrity Practice for Securities and Futures Operating Institutions and Their Staff." According to Article 32 of the "Compliance Measures" and Article 64 of the "Sponsorship Measures," the CSRC decided to take administrative corrective measures against the company.

headlines.title: 截至2025年末 全国超5353万人享受老年人津补贴
headlines.summary: 《2025年度国家老龄事业发展公报》显示，我国老年人福利津补贴覆盖范围继续扩大。截至2025年末，全国享受老年人津补贴人数5353.8万人，其中高龄津贴4145.9万人，护理补贴91.6万人，养老服务补贴585.8万人，综合补贴530.5万人。2025年，全国各级财政用于养老服务和老年人福利领域的支出约1200亿元，其中中央财政支出超300亿元。全国共有60周岁及以上持证残疾老年人1974.2万人，残疾人两项补贴惠及1043万残疾老年人，占领取残疾人两项补贴人数的50.4%。

headlines.title_en: By the end of 2025, over 53.53 million people nationwide received elderly allowance subsidies.
headlines.summary_en: The 2025 National Report on Aging Development shows continued expansion in coverage of elderly welfare allowances. By end-2025, 53.538 million elderly people nationwide received welfare allowances, including 41.459 million for senior age allowances, 916,000 for nursing allowances, 5.858 million for elderly care service allowances, and 5.305 million for comprehensive allowances. In 2025, fiscal spending at all government levels on elderly care services and welfare for seniors totaled about 120 billion yuan, with central fiscal expenditure exceeding 30 billion yuan. Nationwide, 19.742 million disabled elderly people aged 60 and above held disability certificates, and the two disability subsidies benefited 10.43 million disabled seniors, accounting for 50.4% of all recipients of these subsidies.

headlines.title: 世贸组织：2026年第一季度全球货物贸易增长超出预期
headlines.summary: 当地时间7月31日，世界贸易组织发布最新数据，2026年第一季度全球货物贸易增长超出预期。人工智能相关电子元件贸易大幅增长，抵消了中东战争在该季度最后一个月造成的负面影响。经季节性调整后，今年第一季度全球货物贸易量环比增长1.9%，同比增长3.2%。亚洲第一季度出口和进口同比分别增长12.9%和14.6%，主要受中国、新加坡、韩国、泰国等经济体推动。北美出口同比增长7%，进口同比下降10.7%。世贸组织预计下一季度的贸易数据将更全面地反映霍尔木兹海峡的贸易中断情况。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: WTO: Global goods trade growth in Q1 2026 exceeded expectations
headlines.summary_en: On July 31 local time, the World Trade Organization released latest data showing that global merchandise trade growth in the first quarter of 2026 exceeded expectations. The significant growth in trade of AI-related electronic components offset the negative impact caused by the Middle East war in the last month of the quarter. After seasonal adjustment, global merchandise trade volume increased by 1.9% quarter-on-quarter and 3.2% year-on-year in the first quarter of this year. Asia's first-quarter exports and imports increased by 12.9% and 14.6% year-on-year respectively, mainly driven by economies such as China, Singapore, South Korea, and Thailand. North American exports increased by 7% year-on-year, while imports decreased by 10.7% year-on-year. The WTO expects next quarter's trade data to more fully reflect the trade disruption in the Strait of Hormuz. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 中创智领：拟以3亿元-4亿元回购公司A股股份

headlines.title_en: Zhongchuang Zhiling: Plans to repurchase A-share shares worth 300 million to 400 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, July 31: Zhongchuang Zhiling announced plans to repurchase its A-share shares for no less than RMB 300 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 400 million (inclusive), with a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 21 per share (inclusive). Of the A-share shares repurchased this time, 50% will be cancelled to reduce the company's registered capital, and 50% will be used for future equity incentives/employee stock ownership plans. The repurchase funds will come from the company's own or self-raised funds, and the repurchase period is 12 months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase plan.
